evals.prompt: is our checkout page accessible for screen reader users? evals/files/sample-repo/src/app/checkout/checkout.component.html
evals.expected_output: No: the email field has no accessible name, the product image has no alt, the delete icon button has no name, the Apply coupon div is not keyboard reachable, and the confirmation dialog has no name, no aria-modal and no focus trap. Each with line numbers, WCAG criteria, and an Angular remediation (label for / mat-label, [alt], aria-label, button element, cdkTrapFocus + aria-labelledby). Notes the name and phone fields are fine.
expectations: Lists the unlabeled email input, the img without alt, the icon-only button, the clickable div and the dialog with line numbers
Each issue cites a WCAG 2.2 criterion
Remediation for the dialog mentions a focus trap (cdkTrapFocus) and aria-labelledby or aria-label
Does not flag the name or phone fields
